Name: Pupsis Softer Footsteps Sounds
Author: PupsiMupsi
Description:
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The original mod literally saved my eardrums back in the day, so I couldn't live without softer footsteps in [b]1.6[/b]!

This lightweight Content Patcher mod replaces the loud, harsh vanilla footstep sounds on [b]snow[/b] and [b]wood[/b] with much softer, more pleasant audio files.[/color]



[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Features[/b][/size][/color][color=#D4D4D8]

• Softer snow footsteps (using KatiKnitt's original audio files).

• Softer wood footsteps.

• Both can be toggled on/off separately via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]  [b]Note:[/b] [i]You may need to restart the game for changes to take effect.[/i][/color]

[youtube]PfORjjre7EY[/youtube]


[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Installation & Uninstallation[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]

1. Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].
2. Download this mod and extract the folder into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory.
3. Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[i](Optional)[/i] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] if you want to toggle the individual footstep sounds in the in-game settings menu.

[b][u]Uninstallation:[/u][/b]

Simply delete the [b][Pupsis Softer Footsteps][/b] folder from your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] directory at any time.
It's completely safe to remove whenever you want![/color]



[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Credits & Permissions[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]A huge thank you to [b]KatiKnitt[/b] for creating the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14631]Softer Snow Footstep Sound[/url] mod!

The snow footstep audio assets used in this mod are included with explicit permission from KatiKnitt.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Please show some love and check out their original mod page as well![/color]
